scores.evidence: J-1: Specimen Check-In & Barcode Generation … covers [F-001 / FR-01], [AC-001], [AC-002] ... J-2 … covers [F-002 / FR-02], [AC-003], [AC-004] ... J-3 … covers [F-003 / FR-03], [AC-005], [AC-006] ... J-4 … covers [F-004 / FR-04], [AC-007], [AC-008]
Each screen (S-01 to S-05) lists **Loading**, **Empty**, **Populated**, **Error**, and **No Permission** states explicitly.
Screens table Auth/Role column cites personas like `[P-01]`, `[P-02]`, `[P-03]`; journeys begin with “([P-01])”, “([P-02])”, “([P-03])”. No invented personas appear.
Navigation section defines Top Bar, Sidebar links to every screen, and states “All primary operational workflows and screens are directly accessible within 2 clicks from the Dashboard (home) screen.”
Screens table Technical Contracts column lists `[API-001]`, `[TBL-01]` etc.; journeys reference the same API and table IDs when describing actions.

“Every foreground text and interactive token passes WCAG 2.2 AA minimum contrast (>= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3:1 for large text/components).” The colour token table lists contrast ratios for each token, e.g., `--color-primary` L: 6.55:1 (PASS) / D: 6.98:1 (PASS), `--color-text` L: 13.60:1 (PASS) / D: 17.06:1 (PASS). Later it states “Full Keyboard Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): All interactive controls are navigable via keyboard with visible focus rings and logical tab order (`[NFR-05]`).” Component definitions also include focus‑ring details (e.g., Button focus: 2px ring).

Design tokens are fully enumerated for both Light and Dark themes with concrete hex values and contrast ratios (see the “Colours” table). All components are listed with default style and interaction states (Hover, Focus, Disabled, Loading) in the “Components” table, e.g., `Button (Primary)` has height, radius, background, focus ring, loading spinner, etc. No placeholders or “TBD” entries are present.

The brief defines three breakpoints with explicit layout adaptations in the “Breakpoints & Responsive Behavior” table (Mobile <640 px, Tablet 640–1024 px, Desktop >1024 px). It also specifies a maximum reading width of 1280 px and details for sidebar collapse, off‑canvas drawer, and column counts per breakpoint. These satisfy the requirement for layout rules across standard breakpoints.
